gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-georgia: Dreamy and drifting, with huge blank stretches between letters. Noto Sans Georgian brings open curves and short ascender stems, a modern, clean footing that lets Starborn keep its spacing as the star.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-glagoli: Sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase with open round shapes that stay legible at small sizes. Noto Sans Glagolitic can shrink happily, while Starborn deserves the bigger size for its drifting, dreamy spacing.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Ethereal Starborn floats its letters far apart, each one lonely in its space. Noto Sans Gothic then settles in with counters like drilled glass beads, and a full paragraph of it flows smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Starborn leaves wide-open blank space between every letter. Noto Sans Grantha is the steadying partner, with tall little letters and open bowls that never snag, pulling dreamy Starborn back to earth.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi brings crayon-tall strokes and modern clarity. Starborn drifts in ethereal, widely spaced letters while those cut-back terminals leave their own big gap, and that shared openness is what makes this pairing work.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-gurmukh: Clean and ethereal at once: Starborn lets its letters drift far apart. Noto Sans Gurmukhi holds the line with tong-like outward terminals and ascenders that barely clear the x-height, a counterweight to all that drift.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Sparse, floaty, faintly strange. Noto Sans Hanunoo grounds it with lowercase that fills most of the height and open terminals, a contemporary steadiness that makes Starborn's dreamy spacing feel intentional.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-imperia: Starborn is all ethereal drift, with huge stretches of blank space between its letters. And Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic can go smaller on the page, since its pincer-open c and short capital steps stay legible.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Starborn scatters its ethereal letters across wide blank space, one dreamy shape at a time. Then Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian takes over, its big open eyes and deep middle band carry whole paragraphs along cleanly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Dreamy from the first glance, Starborn floats wide blank space through every line. Noto Sans Khmer does the practical work with chisel-notch openings and near-capital lowercase, leaving Starborn free to simply be atmospheric.
